mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE recursiveInfo AS (SELECT page_id, page_name, parent_id FROM sys_page WHERE page_id = #{pageId} UNION ALL SELECT a.page_id, a.page_name, a.parent_id FROM sys_page AS a, recursiveInfo AS b WHERE a.parent_id = b.page_id) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(page_Id) AS pageIds FROM recursiveInfo;
